import sys, time, json, os, random
import numpy as np

def verify_perm(p, A, B):
    n = len(p)
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            if p[i] == p[j]:
                continue
            cost_ij = A[i][j] * B[p[i]][p[j]]
            cost_ji = A[j][i] * B[p[j]][p[i]]
            if cost_ij != cost_ji:
                return False
    return True

def compute_cost(p, A, B):
    n = len(p)
    total = 0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            total += A[i][j] * B[p[i]][p[j]]
    return total

def two_swap(p, A, B):
    n = len(p)
    i, j = sorted(random.sample(range(n), 2))
    p[i], p[j] = p[j], p[i]
    return p, compute_cost(p, A, B)

def adaptive_local_search(A, B, time_limit):
    n = len(A)
    p = list(range(n))
    random.shuffle(p)
    best_p = p[:]
    best_cost = compute_cost(p, A, B)
    start = time.time()
    while time.time() - start < time_limit:
        new_p, new_cost = two_swap(p[:], A, B)
        if new_cost < best_cost:
            p = new_p
            best_p = new_p
            best_cost = new_cost
        else:
            p = new_p
    if not verify_perm(best_p, A, B):
        p = list(range(n))
        random.shuffle(p)
        best_p = p
        best_cost = compute_cost(p, A, B)
    return best_p, best_cost

def main():
    if len(sys.argv) < 3:
        return
    json_path = sys.argv[1]
    time_limit = float(sys.argv[2])
    env_limit = float(os.getenv('QAP_TIME_LIMIT_S', time_limit))
    budget = min(time_limit, env_limit)
    with open(json_path) as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    A = np.array(data['A'], dtype=int)
    B = np.array(data['B'], dtype=int)
    n = data['n']
    start_time = time.time()
    best_p, best_cost = adaptive_local_search(A, B, budget - (time.time() - start_time))
    while time.time() - start_time < budget:
        if verify_perm(best_p, A, B):
            break
        best_p, best_cost = adaptive_local_search(A, B, budget - (time.time() - start_time))
    perm_1based = [x + 1 for x in best_p]
    print("PERMUTATION:", " ".join(map(str, perm_1based)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    budget = min(time_limit, env_limit)
